description: List decoded The Standard Reserve (TSR) S-Bills contract events on Robinhood Chain, newest first: deposits, early exits, redemptions, rolls, settlements, bonus distributions, rate changes and admin changes. Filter by eventName, bill_id, or owner, and paginate with before (a "block:log_index" cursor, exclusive) and limit. Fields ending in _raw are 18-decimal integers as strings.

eventName.description: Decoded event name to filter by (e.g. "Deposited", "Exited")

owner.description: Owner address (0x...) to filter by. Any casing is accepted — the gateway lowercases it.

name: 1s_std_sbills_events
title: TSR S-Bills Event Feed
